summary: Server track open/close notification. Chooses the 'opened'/'closed' message verb from flag a2 and stores related session state on `this` (a float timer at +0x2C and a flag at +0x29 cleared on close). When debug logging is enabled (dword_7D0398 nonzero), reads the track name, formats '*** The server {opened|closed} {trackname}', copies it into a heap buffer, appends a node to the debug-log linked list owned by `this` (head +0x1B770, tail +0x1B774, first +0x1B778, count +0x1B77C), renders the message to the UI resource, and conditionally writes it to the debug log via DebugLogWrite (skipped for server sessions, dword_7C569C == 5).

local_names.opened_flag: a2 — selects opened vs closed branch
local_names.message_text: v3 — 'opened'/'closed' string literal selected by flag
local_names.buffer_wrapper: v6 — heap message-buffer wrapper (char**), null if allocation failed
local_names.track_name: v10 — stack buffer holding track name from TrackNameReader
local_names.formatted: v11 — stack buffer holding formatted notification string

operations.description: Branch on opened flag a2: nonzero takes the 'opened' path, zero takes the 'closed' path.
Opened path: select aOpened as message verb and set this+0x2C to 1084227584.
Closed path: select aClosed as message verb, set this+0x2C to -1082130432 (-1.0f), and clear this+0x29 to 0.
Entire notification body gated on global dword_7D0398; when zero, skip the whole block and return.
OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(8) allocates the message-buffer wrapper (char**).
On allocation success the buffer wrapper v5 is initialized (*v5 = 0, v5[1] = -1); on failure v6 is set to 0.
TrackNameReader(v10, 63) reads the current track name into the 64-byte stack buffer.
StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v11, '*** The server %s %s', message_text, track_name) formats the notification string.
StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(v11) copies the formatted message into a reallocating buffer.
Only when the buffer wrapper v6 is non-null, allocate and append a debug-log linked-list node.
OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(12) allocates the 12-byte linked-list node.
Node v7 initialized: [0] = v6 (buffer wrapper), [4] = 0 (next pointer), [8] = 0 (flag byte).
Branch on the existing list head stored at this+0x1B770 to pick append vs first-node path.
Append path: *(*(this+0x1B774)+4) = v7 links the current tail node's next pointer to the new node.
First-node path: this+0x1B770 = v7 (head) and this+0x1B778 = v7 (first).
Tail update: this+0x1B774 = v7; increment the node count at this+0x1B77C.
v8 = *v6 (message string from buffer); when null, fall back to byte_5EA438.
TextLineWrappingAndRendering(&dword_7CD204, v8, 3, 16909060) renders the notification message to the UI resource.
Dev-log write only executed when session type dword_7C569C != 5 (not a server session).
StringSplitLoop(1, aDDevF119992002_1, 4935) checks the dev-path verbosity condition.
Only when StringSplitLoop returned nonzero, write the debug log entry.
DebugLogWrite(&dword_8AD25C, v9) appends the message to the debug log; v9 falls back to byte_5EA438 when *v6 is null.
Return the accumulated result value (the dword_7D0398 guard value, or the last call result).
